editor.description: The text editor command used for editing the reminders file. Corresponds to the EDITOR environment variable.

pager.description: The pager program used to view keybindings, calendars, and reminders. Corresponds to the PAGER environment variable.

show_calendar.description: Whether to display the calendar grid by default.

show_reminders.description: Whether to display the list of reminders by default.

date_format.description: The format string for dates in the display. Uses strftime syntax.

time_format.description: The format string for times in the display. Uses strftime syntax.

reminder_paths.description: A list of file paths or directories containing .rem reminder files to include. Supports environment variable expansion if the tool handles it, otherwise literal paths.
